label: Week 3
title: Exploring back pain
description: 대화문을 읽을 때는 단어 하나하나를 외우기보다는 전체적인 대화의 흐름과 질문하는 방식에 집중해 주세요.
scenario: John은 약 6주 전부터 허리 통증을 경험하고 있습니다. 오랫동안 앉아 있으면 통증이 심해지고, 일어나서 잠깐 걸으면 조금 나아지는 상황입니다.
expressions: Can you tell me more about what's been happening with your back?
What tends to make it worse?
Does anything seem to help it settle?
And how's it affecting you day to day?

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Can you tell me more about what's been happening with your back?
lines.ko: 허리에 어떤 일이 있었는지 좀 더 말씀해 주시겠어요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: My back has been feeling achy for a while now.
lines.ko: 허리가 뻐근하게 아픈 지 좀 됐어요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Okay. Whereabouts in your back do you feel it?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Mostly in the middle of my lower back.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: And when did you first notice it?

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Right. What tends to make it worse?
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 주로 어떤 때 더 아프세요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Sitting at my desk for too long, especially when I'm working.
lines.ko: 책상에 너무 오래 앉아 있으면요. 특히 일할 때요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: I see. Does anything seem to help it settle?
lines.ko: 그렇군요. 통증을 가라앉히는 데 도움이 되는 게 있나요?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Getting up and having a bit of a walk usually helps.
lines.ko: 일어나서 잠깐 걸으면 보통 좀 나아져요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: And how's it affecting you day to day?

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Are you finding anything particularly difficult?

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: It's making it hard to sit through long meetings at work.
lines.ko: 직장에서 긴 회의가 끝날 때까지 앉아 있기가 힘들어요.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: Okay, so sitting for long periods makes it worse,
lines.ko: 정리하면, 오래 앉아 있으면 더 아프고,

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: and getting up for a short walk seems to help.

lines.speaker: Physio
lines.en: It's also affecting how long you can sit at work.
lines.ko: 직장에서 오래 앉아 있는 데도 영향을 주고 있고요.

lines.speaker: Patient
lines.en: Not really. It's mainly just the ache in my lower back.
lines.ko: 딱히 없어요. 주로 허리 아래쪽이 뻐근하게 아픈 정도예요.
